Recently this polymorphism was described to explain a significant part of the variance in the AO in HD [

hCAD

TP53
and

targets.authors: Chattopadhyay B, Baksi K, Mukhopadhyay S, Bhattacharyya NP
targets.title: Modulation of age at onset of Huntington disease patients by variations in TP53 and human caspase activated DNase (hCAD) genes

targets.outcome_quote:
Our study failed to replicate the association between the genotypes at the R72P polymorphism in
TP53
and R196K polymorphism in
hCAD
genes with the AO of HD.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The conclusion explicitly says the association failed to replicate. The additional case-control retest also disagrees with the same original paper.

reasoning: An independent German cohort retests the published TP53 and hCAD associations of Chattopadhyay et al. Reference 8 identifies the single target paper; the earlier Arning cohort paper supplies data context rather than the association being tested.
